meta.name: Rudrabinar Obhishaap
meta.description:
Rudrapur and Anandagarh are two legendary schools of Indian classical music. However, these two places have a common past so dark that its revelation may change many lives forever.

Complete series. On your server: S1 9/9 | S2 8/8

videos.title: Naad
videos.overview: The present Naad traces the history between Rudrapur and Anandagarh, albeit in his innate violent way. On the day of Alap and Shruti's engagement, Naad reaches Anandagarh in search of the thing that can free his community from the curse of the Rudrabina!

videos.title: Rudrabinar Chinho
videos.overview: As everyone at the Anandagarh mansion awaits the arrival of Salamat, a piece of shocking news shakes them to the core.  While Rohini gets trapped in Rudrapur, Alap and Shruti discover a mysterious box in the mansion's music room.

videos.title: Amanat Khaner Chakti
videos.overview: Alap and Shruti rescue Madhubanti from a fatal situation. Rohini finally understands the evil intentions of Rudrabhairab.

videos.title: Sabdhan
videos.overview: Madhubanti shows the discs Amanat Khan gifted her and Ranjan. Alap realises that each disc is a clue that will help them to learn about Tansen's Raga Sanjivani.

videos.title: Rudrapurer Naari
videos.overview: As Saaz plays the clarinet at Salamat's grave, Naad goes there with a sinister plan. Alap and Shruti visit Ramnidhi in search of Amanat Khan's disc without realising that they are in mortal peril.

videos.title: Madantir Bongshodhor
videos.overview: Bahadur gives Alap two vital pieces of information. Madhubanti meets Naad en route to the Anandagarh Music Conference and takes responsibility for his training.

videos.title: Rahashyamoy Swaralipi
videos.overview: Bahadur's suspicious behaviour makes Alap even more determined to get to the root of the mystery. Alap and Naad take part in an impromptu music competition at Shruti's insistence, but the result is far from expected!

videos.title: Rawkter Taan
videos.overview: Naad kills another veteran musician. Alap and Shruti come across a strange sight at the graveyard.

videos.title: Chaktir Hodish
videos.overview: Rohini is happy to know that Moti has planned to get her out of Rudrapur. Alap finally gets his hands on the discs that Amanat Khan gave to Noor and Salamat.

videos.title: Swaralipir Kut Taan
videos.overview: Alap manages to get his hands on all of Amanat Khan's discs. But the discovery of a link between Salamat and Kedar further complicates things.

videos.title: Arek Naad
videos.overview: Naad comes to Anandagarh with a vicious plan. Alap and Shruti discover the gruesome past of Kedar and his connection with the mysterious symbol.

videos.title: Anandagarh-er Akhhyan
videos.overview: Kedar's past and the death of Madanti's descendants are connected. Anandagarh's hidden history comes to light when Alap and Shruti try to get to the root of Anadi's disappearance.

videos.title: Udara
videos.overview: Ramnidhi reveals Rudrabhairab's mission. Alap seems to be on the brink of untangling the mystery of Raga Sanjivani.

videos.title: Saat Surer Mejaj
videos.overview: Alap and Shruti meet Sangeetguru Shashikanta Mishra to crack the mystery of Raga Sanjivani. Naad takes a drastic step that upends everything.

videos.title: Jogphawl
videos.overview: When Rudrabhairab reveals himself to everyone, Rudrapur's Shivmandir becomes the chamber of secrets. Alap finally cracks the code to finding the elusive Raga Sanjivani.

videos.title: Raga Sanjivani
videos.overview: Finding Raga Sanjivani may not be enough for Alap as Rudrabhairab throws him an almost impossible challenge.

videos.title: Mumtaz-er Konya
videos.overview: Rudrabhairab's actions turn Naad's life upside down. A set of new revelations stuns everyone as they meet Mumtaz's real daughter.
